name: rc-vscode
description: Unofficial VS Code chat panel for RpCli (rc) by RezaParsian — maintained by hanyehkhl

rc.token.description: DeepSeek token (optional if ~/.config/rp-cli/.env already has DEEPSEEK_TOKEN)

rc.cliPath.description: Optional override path to cli.js. Leave empty to use the CLI bundled inside this extension.

rc.nodePath.description: Optional override. Leave empty to use the Node.js binary bundled in the extension.

rc.velocity.enabled.description: Deprecated — use rc.velocity.mode. Only consulted when rc.velocity.mode is unset.

rc.velocity.daemonPort.description: Loopback port for the Velocity Python daemon.

rc.velocity.servePort.description: Loopback port for bundled rc serve.

rc.velocity.stream.description: Stream tokens through Velocity when rc serve is available.

rc.agent.editorContext.description: Send the active file, selection, diagnostics, and git status with each prompt so the agent can resolve references like "this function".

rc.agent.sessionMemory.description: Reuse one DeepSeek session per chat thread instead of re-sending the transcript each turn.

rc.agent.autoContinue.description: Automatically resume when the agent hits the tool-round ceiling mid-task.

rc.agent.maxContinues.description: Maximum automatic continuations for a single turn.

rc.agent.verifyEdits.description: After the agent edits files, feed any resulting language-server errors back so it can fix them.

rc.agent.maxVerifyRounds.description: Maximum self-repair rounds after an edit introduces errors.

rc.agent.maxToolRounds.description: Tool rounds the agent may take before pausing (upstream default is 10).

enumDescriptions: Switch the daemon on by itself once a turn runs slow.
Route every turn through the daemon.
rc.velocity.mode.description: When the Velocity daemon handles a turn. Auto engages it after a slow turn; the daemon then runs its own detectors (context bloat, wander, retry loops).

rc.velocity.autoTriggerSeconds.description: In Auto mode, a turn slower than this many seconds hands the rest of the chat to the daemon.

rc.agent.runChecks.description: After the agent edits files, run the project's type-checker and feed any failures back so it can fix them. Only non-mutating checks are auto-detected (npm run typecheck, tsc --noEmit, cargo check, go vet).

rc.agent.checkCommand.description: Command used to verify the agent's edits. Leave empty to auto-detect. Runs in the workspace root — use a check that does not write build output.

rc.agent.checkTimeoutMs.description: Timeout for the verification command, in milliseconds.

rc.agent.grounding.description: Append anti-hallucination rules to the system prompt: never describe or edit code without reading it first, never invent APIs, match the surrounding style.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run bundle-node && npm run prepare-cli && npm run compile
scripts.velocity:check: py -3 -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'velocity-daemon'); from velocity.api.app import create_app; print('velocity ok')"
